These are estimates from general knowledge of NAS-Bench-201 patterns, not from the benchmark data, since I didn't query it. Interaction effects are usually small and inconsistent across datasets, so most claims get low probabilities. The exceptions are cases where the edge is currently `none`, so replacing it with a conv op adds a whole path.
